final: WITH step1 AS (SELECT cr.raceId, c.country, SUM(cr.points) AS total_points, COUNT(*) AS record_count FROM constructorResults AS cr JOIN races AS r ON r.raceId = cr.raceId JOIN circuits AS c ON c.circuitId = r.circuitId GROUP BY cr.raceId, c.country), step2 AS (SELECT AVG(record_count) AS avg_count FROM step1), threshold AS (SELECT MIN(record_count) AS min_count FROM (SELECT record_count FROM step1 ORDER BY record_count DESC LIMIT 10)) SELECT s.raceId, s.country, s.total_points, s.record_count, s.record_count - a.avg_count FROM step1 AS s CROSS JOIN step2 AS a CROSS JOIN threshold AS t WHERE a.avg_count IS NOT NULL AND s.record_count > a.avg_count AND s.record_count >= t.min_count ORDER BY s.record_count - a.avg_count DESC
